short_summary: Initializes the standard CRC32 lookup table using the polynomial 0xEDB88320.
detailed_summary: The function loops 256 times from `ecx = 0` to `255`. In each iteration, it performs 8 consecutive bit-shift and conditional XOR operations corresponding to an unrolled computation for a single byte value (`ecx`). The resulting 32-bit CRC value is stored into the lookup table array `dword_422860` at index `ecx`. After the loop completes, it sets a global initialization flag (`byte_42285D`) to 1 to prevent re-initialization.
side_effects: populates the CRC32 lookup table at dword_422860 (256 dwords)
sets the global initialization flag byte_42285D to 1
